faq_heading: Homes near Richardson Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Richardson Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Delta School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Richardson Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active houses, townhomes and condos whose listing description names Richardson Elementary. MLS® listings are not tagged by school, so a nearby home whose listing does not name the school will not show, and a listing that does can be farther than 1 km away.

How the Richardson Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Richardson Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away.
